text:
sam: FYI we're scheduling MIG-3081 (split profile.settings -> settings_v2 + staged backfill) in tonight's change window at 02:00 UTC. Expect short per-shard exclusive locks during ALTER.

deploybot: MIG-3081 scheduled for 2026-01-08 02:00 UTC in release 2026.01.08. To cancel: /deploy cancel MIG-3081. Canary pin: backend v3.0.2 for 20m.

maya: please avoid full-table UPDATE. will do chunked backfill.

ravi: plan: chunk size 400 rows, sleep 150ms. job sets statement_timeout=25s. metrics emitted: backfill_batches, batch_duration_ms, recent_lock_ms.

ops-bot: monitor rule created -> PagerDuty on infra.query.lock_wait > 40s for 90s.

sam: rollback criteria draft: 1) sustained lock_wait > 60s for 3m, 2) deadlock_count > 4 in 10m, 3) canary 5xx > 2% for 5m. If triggered: abort remaining jobs, unapply schema (run revert DDL), unpin services to v3.0.1, and toggle feature flag off.

maya: add automated preflight: run dry-run backfill on staging, apply schema on staging replica, run smoke writes, confirm canary pin, dashboards created.

sam: holdpoints: PRE-ALTER (manual continue) and POST-5K-BACKFILL (auto-pause for canary). deploybot: holdpoints registered.

ravi: compatibility shim in v3.0.2 will read from settings_v2 with fallback to settings and write to both for 30m.

maya: release note blurb: "MIG-3081: split profile.settings to settings_v2 with safe chunked backfill. Services pinned during rollout. No downtime expected; brief shard locks possible." will post to #release-notes 30m before.

sam: added alert for deadlock spikes: if deadlock_count > 3 in 5m send high-priority PM to #oncall-db.

deploybot: MIG-3081 status: queued -> preflight at 01:30 UTC. Next update: 01:45 preflight check.

ravi: i'll own backfill job and instrumentation. i'll also provide a teardown script for quick abort.

maya: i'll be oncall during window. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks all.
